'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**[[Withdrawal of U.S. troops from Afghanistan]], [[Afghan peace process]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] warns that the [[United States|country]] will not meet the [[2021 withdrawal of U.S. troops from Afghanistan|May 1 deadline]] to withdraw from [[Afghanistan]]. However, he also said that it is unlikely that troops will remain in the country next year. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-biden-afghanistan-idUSKBN2BH2XC (Reuters)]
**The [[Bundestag]] approves a new mandate to let [[Germany]] continue to station up to 1,300 [[Bundeswehr]] soldiers in Afghanistan until January 31, 2022. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-germany-defence/germany-extends-military-mission-in-afghanistan-into-2022-idUSKBN2BH34J?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The 2021 redesign of the [[£50 note]], featuring British mathematician [[Alan Turing]] on the reverse, is officially unveiled by the [[Bank of England]]. It is slated to enter circulation on June 23, Turing's birthday. [https://abcnews.go.com/Business/wireStory/wwii-codebreaker-alan-turing-honored-uk-bank-note-76672349 (ABC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tornado outbreak of March 24–26, 2021]] 
**[[List of governors of Alabama|Alabama Governor]] [[Kay Ivey]] declares a [[state of emergency]] for 46 counties as the [[National Weather Service]] predicts a severe weather outbreak and possible tornado outbreak. [https://abc3340.com/news/local/state-of-emergency-issued-for-28-alabama-counties-as-severe-weather-approaches (WBMA-TV)]
**The [[National Weather Service]] issues a [[particularly dangerous situation]] tornado watch after level 5 "high risk" watches are issued for parts of [[Alabama]], [[Mississippi]], and [[Tennessee]].  [https://www.al.com/news/2021/03/rare-level-5-risk-for-severe-weather-for-part-of-alabama-today-tornadoes-possible-nearly-statewide.html (AL.com)]
**A [[tornado emergency]] was issued by the [[National Weather Service]] near [[Hoover, Alabama]]. Another emergency was also issued for [[Brent, Alabama|Brent]] and [[Centreville, Alabama|Centreville]]. [https://www.alabamawx.com/?p=225759 (Alabama WX)]
*[[2021 Suez Canal obstruction]]
**The [[Suez Canal Authority]] suspends navigation through the [[Suez Canal]] until the grounded [[container ship]] ''[[Ever Given]]'' can be refloated. The waterway has now been blocked for three consecutive days. [https://www.france24.com/en/business/20210325-egypt-temporarily-suspends-navigation-through-suez-canal-blocked-by-cargo-ship (France 24)]
*[[February 13–17, 2021 North American winter storm]], [[February 15–20, 2021 North American winter storm]], [[2021 Texas power crisis]]
**The official death toll from the major [[winter storm]]s that struck [[Texas]] and triggered statewide blackouts last month rises to at least 111, more than double the previous reported numbers. It is also believed that the storms could become the costliest weather disaster in the state's history. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/death-toll-texas-winter-storm-grows-more-100-n1262115 (NBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iraq]]
****[[Iraq]] receives 336,000 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] distributed through the [[COVAX]] vaccine sharing initiative. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1831812/middle-east (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] reports a record 8,773 new confirmed cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 693,048. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/03/25/21/ph-logs-8773-addl-covid-19-cases-a-new-record-high-active-infections-swell-to-nearly-100k (ABS-CBN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] surpasses 100,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20210325003000320 (Yonhap News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****The [[Thailand]] Food and Drug Administration grants emergency use authorization for the single-dose [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] vaccine, thereby becoming the third vaccine to be made available for local use. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/thailand-johnson-johnson-single-dose-covid-19-vaccine-14489322 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Albania]]
****[[Albania]] receives their first shipment of 192,000 doses of the [[Sinovac]] [[CoronaVac]] vaccine. [https://albaniandailynews.com/news/192-000-chinese-vaccine-doses-arrive-in-albania--1-1 (Albanian Daily News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****The [[Government of France]] extends the partial [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] to the [[Departments of France|department]]s of [[Rhône (department)|Rhône]], [[Aube]], and [[Nièvre]] due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 infections. The restrictions will begin at midnight tomorrow. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/03/25/covid-19-in-europe-france-extends-partial-lockdowns-to-more-parts-of-country-as-cases-surg (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] reports a record 272 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 19,224. [https://dailynewshungary.com/ominous-covid-19-record-number-of-deaths-at-a-new-peak-in-hungary/ (Daily News Hungary)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] will close barbers, hairdressers, and beauty shops from March 27 until April 9, as well as kindergartens and nurseries, while restricting the capacity at essential shops, churches, public markets, and post offices amidst the rising number of the COVID-19 cases. [https://www.thefirstnews.com/article/poland-imposes-tougher-pandemic-measures-20789 (The First News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] reports a record 16,669 new confirmed cases and 362 deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,596,575 and the nationwide death toll to 31,135. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-society/3214845-ukraine-reports-16669-new-coronavirus-cases.html (Ukrinform)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
****[[Brazil]] reports a record 100,158 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7720211/brazil-record-cases-covid-19/ (Global News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
****[[Chile]] reports nearly 50,000 active cases of COVID-19, a new record for the country. The country also announces that the entire [[Santiago Metropolitan Region]] will be put under lockdown beginning next Saturday. [https://www.biobiochile.cl/noticias/nacional/chile/2021/03/25/chile-roza-los-50-mil-casos-activos-de-covid-19-record-en-la-pandemia.shtml (''BíoBíoChile'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia]]
****[[Colombia]] grants emergency use authorization for the single-dose [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] vaccine. [https://www.europapress.es/internacional/noticia-colombia-aprueba-uso-emergencia-vacuna-johnson-johnson-20210326035437.html (Europa Press)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Peru]]
****[[Peru]] reports a record 11,260 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,492,519. [https://riotimesonline.com/brazil-news/miscellaneous/covid-19/peru-hits-new-covid-case-record-as-brazilian-variant-spreads/ (''The Rio Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Virginia]], [[variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
*****[[Virginia]] reports its two first cases of the highly contagious SARS-CoV-2 variant first detected in [[California]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states/virginia/articles/2021-03-25/virginia-reports-first-cases-of-california-covid-19-variants (U.S. News and World Report)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico]] surpasses 200,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-mexico/mexicos-confirmed-coronavirus-death-toll-surpasses-200000-idUSE1N2K202J (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[AstraZeneca]] announces that the efficacy rating of its [[COVID-19 vaccine]] candidate has been lowered to 76%, following new analyses of the trial run in the [[United States]]. Earlier in the week, the company had been criticized for advertising its vaccine with a 79% efficacy rating using what critics claimed was outdated data. [https://fortune.com/2021/03/24/astrazeneca-covid-vaccine-new-efficacy-rate-outdated-data/ (''Forbes'')]
***[[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Pfizer]] and [[BioNTech]] begin a clinical trial testing of their COVID-19 vaccine on healthy children between the ages of six months and 11 years, which is considered a crucial step towards vaccinating children. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/03/25/covid-vaccine-pfizer-begins-trial-on-infants-and-young-kids.html (CNBC)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Andorra–Spain relations]]
**King [[Felipe VI]] of Spain makes the first ever state visit by a [[Monarchy of Spain|Spanish king]] to [[Andorra]]. [https://www.elperiodico.com/es/sociedad/20210325/reyes-recibidos-andorra-11610275 (''El Periódico'')]
*Aftermath of the [[2021 Myanmar coup d'état]]
**The [[United States]] and the [[United Kingdom]] impose sanctions on Burmese conglomerates [[Myanma Economic Holdings Limited|Myanma Economic Holdings]] and [[Myanmar Economic Corporation]], citing the crackdown and human rights violations committed by the [[State Administration Council|military junta]] since taking power on February 1. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-politics-usa-sanctions/u-s-and-britain-blacklist-myanmar-military-controlled-companies-idUSKBN2BH1VM (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020–2021 Belarusian protests]]
**Opposition leader [[Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya]] calls for a "Freedom Day" and renewed protests against [[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] in order to mount pressure for him to resign amidst a disputed election last year. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belarus-election-protests/belarusian-opposition-calls-for-new-wave-of-protests-against-lukashenko-idUSKBN2BH1PU?il=0 (Reuters)]
